title: Speakwow course unit
description: The front matter of one unit page, courses/<slug>/units/NN-title.md: what the student should be able to do, and what the teacher needs to get them there. An outline only: never copy passages, dialogues, worked examples or exercises from a textbook. 一个单元的提纲，不要抄课本原文、例题或练习。

position.description: 1 for the first unit; must match the file number (01-….md). Never renumber a published unit: students' progress points at it. Add new units at the end. 单元序号，与文件名一致；已发布的单元不要改序号。

title.description: Unit title, as printed when the course follows a book. 单元标题。

subtitle.description: A second title, e.g. the Chinese title of an English unit. 副标题，例如中文标题。

theme.description: A theme category, e.g. 人与自我 / 人与社会 / 人与自然 in the 2022 English standard. 主题。

topic.description: What the unit is about, in a sentence. 话题。

goals.description: What the student can do by the end: 3 to 8 goals the teacher works on and scores after each lesson. 学完能做到什么，3–8 条，课后会逐条评分。

id.description: u<position>-g<number>, e.g. u3-g2. Never change or reuse an id: each student's score for the goal is stored under it. To retire a goal, delete it and give the next one a new number. 目标 ID，永远不要改或复用。

kind.description: What kind of goal, one lowercase word. Language courses: speaking, listening, reading, writing, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation. Any subject: concept (know and explain an idea), skill (do something step by step), application (use it in a new situation), reasoning (argue, compare, judge). 目标类型。

text.description: Something the student can do, starting with a verb: "Introduce yourself and a friend", "Explain why the moon has phases". 用动词开头，写成能做到的事。

terms.description: Key words and terms: the vocabulary of a language unit, the terminology of any other subject. Up to 30. 词汇或术语。

points.description: Key points the teacher makes sure land: grammar points, concepts, rules, formulas, each in a short phrase. 知识点：语法、概念、规则、公式。

activities.description: Things to do together on a call, written for Speakwow (never copied): a role play, explaining a step, a question to argue about, a problem to talk through. 通话里可以一起做的事，原创。

pitfalls.description: Mistakes and misunderstandings students at this level often have. 学生常见的错误和误解。

sources.description: Where the content comes from, so learners and maintainers can read the original. Cite, never copy. 资料来源：只引用，不照抄。

review.description: How far this outline has been checked, so maintainers know what still needs a look. 核对状态。

status.description: draft: not checked yet / cross-checked: matched against at least two independent sources / source-checked: checked against the textbook itself or another primary source.

notes.description: What was checked against what, and what is still uncertain. 核对说明。
